subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live owner-session Telegram delivery proof, or is the current source/test proof sufficient for this session-routing change?
rationale: The code path looks narrowly correct, but the remaining gap is proof of a user-visible Telegram topic/session delivery path that tests and CI do not fully exercise.

options.title: Require live delivery proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only proof
options.body: Merge with source, regression-test, and CI evidence only, while owning the risk that the real transport path still misroutes or drops the completion.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery contract
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one canonical completion-wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths before changing runtime routing.

recommendation.title: Require live delivery proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent task and subagent completion history makes this the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
